opus.problem: The clue names both Jacob and Esau as this man's sons, and the blessing scene is one of his best-known stories. A baker who reads only this clue can answer at once, so it is not medium hard. A single clue should not give the word away.

Naming his wife Rebekah gives the word away, since Rebekah's husband is well known. Without her name the clue would also fit Abraham, who told the same lie about Sarah in Gerar. Either way it breaks the rules: as written it reveals the answer, and without the name it is ambiguous. The clue needs another detail to set it apart.
